title: Add one-command MVP demo workflow

context.summary: Make the local MVP demo easy to start, seed and verify with one command.
context.background: The current demo requires manually starting Compose, seeding demo credentials and running acceptance. A polished MVP should expose a single ergonomic local command.

in: Add a root script such as pnpm mvp:up or pnpm mvp:demo.
Start Docker Compose with the required local profiles.
Run migrations and demo seed automatically.
Wait for API/worker readiness before running acceptance or printing next steps.
Provide clear teardown and reset commands.
Update README and MVP acceptance docs.
out: Hide failures by continuing after failed healthchecks.
Require paid external providers for the default demo path.

acceptance_criteria: A single documented command can start the local MVP stack and seed demo credentials.
The command waits for required services to become healthy.
The command can optionally run live acceptance.
README points a new developer to the one-command demo path.

manual_checks: Run the one-command demo locally with Docker available.
Confirm errors are actionable when Docker is unavailable.

risks: Cross-platform shell differences can make one-command workflows fragile.
Docker startup time can make readiness checks flaky if timeouts are too short.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
